## ozet

Explain to the client how to use the deposit savings for regular income at low risk.

## talking_points

The deposit savings fell behind inflation last year. A money market fund gives same-day access at low risk. All three recommendations stay inside the low risk limit.

## teklif_metni

“You can keep your savings in deposits; but if you put a part into low-risk funds with same-day access, last year's data suggests a better chance to stay above inflation.”

## oneriler

Nurol Portföy Para Piyasası (TL) Fonu: explain the above-category return and the short sale settlement. Kuveyt Kısa Vadeli Borçlanma Araçları Fonu: explain the above-category return and the short sale settlement. Yapı Kredi Borçlanma Araçları Fonu: explain the above-category return and the short sale settlement.

## dikkat

Say that all three recommendations depend on TL interest rates.

## alternatifler

ING e-Vadeli gives a fixed rate for 32 days.

## sorular

Ask how often the client needs the income.

## varsayimlar

The amount was assumed in the 100,000–249,999 TL tier.
